sections_target.text: [[MISSING]] Testing the 87 T differential unit minimum pickup

items: أجرِ توصيلات الاختبار كما هو موضح في الشكل 1 لأزواج أوجه 87T المراد اختبارها.
[[MISSING]] Set the primary and secondary currents to 0.07 (W1) & 1 (W2) amperes RMS.
[[MISSING]] Set primary and secondary current source angles to 0 degrees
طبّق التيارات.

[[MISSING]] Slowly raise the current from 0.1 (1) amperes RMS until the rlay trips. The contact monitor should indicate a closed contact. The "Differential" target along with the phase target should light. This should occur when the secondary current reaches 0.12 (1.4) amperes RMS 3 %

sections_target.text: [[MISSING]] Testing the 87 T differential unit with adjustable percent slope setting

items: أجرِ توصيلات الاختبار كما هو موضح في الشكل 1 لأزواج أوجه 87T المراد اختبارها.
[[MISSING]] Set the primary and secondary currents to 0.30 (9) amperes RMS.
[[MISSING]] Set the secondary current source angles to 180 degrees
طبّق التيارات.

[[MISSING]] Slowly raise the secondary current RMS until the relay trips. The contact monitor should indicate a closed contact. The "Differential" target along with the phase target should light. This should occur when the secondary current reaches 0.7 (9.4) amperes RMS 3 %

sections_target.text: [[MISSING]] Testing the 87 T differential unit with harmonic restraint

items: [[MISSING]] Make the test connections as shown in figure 1 for the 87T HARM phase pairs to be tested (both sources synchronized and in parallel)
[[MISSING]] Set current source to 0.40 (4.70) amperes RMS at 0 degrees 50 hz. Set current source 2 to 0.1 (1) amperes RMS at 0 degrees 100 hz

[[MISSING]] Apply the currents. The TPU-2000R display should read "Trip restrained" Slowly lower only current source 2 from 0.1 (1) amperes RMS until the relay trips. The contact monitor should indicate a closed current source 2 is 0.06 (0.705) amperes RMS
[[MISSING]] Verify or change the following PRIMARY settings from this test:
[[MISSING]] 51 N-1 Selection 51 N-1= Disable
[[MISSING]] Make the test connections as shown in figure 1 from the 87 H phase pairs to be tested.
[[MISSING]] Set the current source 1 to 2.50 (28.3) amperes RMS at 50 hz.

[[MISSING]] Set current source 2 to 2.50 (28.3) A at 100 Hz Suddenly apply the current for 1 second. The relay should trip. The contact monitor should indicate a closed contact. The "Differential" target along with the phase target light. Go to the fault records and verify that the 87 H unit initiated the last trip.
[[MISSING]] Set 87 T disable, make test connection as in fig. 1,
[[MISSING]] Set the timer to start upon application of current.
[[MISSING]] Set the current source to 0.3 A the 50 N-1 should trip and the neutral target should light, the tested time should be 5 sec. for stage 1 & 5.5 sec. for stage 2
[[MISSING]] Return relay to service by removing the test plugs, and switch on test switches.
[[MISSING]] Check relay configuration and logic
